1f2bb998a2d92574.summary: Dermatologists explain why multi-blade cartridge razors cause ingrown hairs and why switching to a single-blade safety razor gives a cleaner, irritation-free shave. Hook: 'Multi-blade razors are actually ruining your skin: why dermatologists recommend single-blade safety razors.'
1f2bb998a2d92574.notes:
- The physics of cartridge razors: lift-and-cut mechanism cuts hair below follicle line, causing ingrown hairs
- Single blade safety razor cuts flush with skin surface with zero tugging
- Cost efficiency: double-edge stainless steel blades cost ₹3-5 each vs ₹250 for multi-blade cartridges
- Shaving technique: 30-degree blade angle and zero downward pressure
